description: This file defines a static generic class `TypeProps<T>` for determining type properties related to atomic write capabilities, including checking if a type can be written atomically based on its characteristics and type code.

classes.name: TypeProps<T>
classes.description: A static class providing properties and methods to determine if the generic type T can be written atomically.

methods.description: Private method that checks type T against rules from ECMA CLI to determine if write operations are atomic.
